gaps.remaining: All five original behalf routes are directly registered: records, buyer selection, product/cart, confirm and cashier; a new read-only detail route was not an original PHP manifest route. Registration and local synthetic tests do not establish full PHP flow parity. Confirm has scoped quote/create, delivery, candidate coupons, points, authoritative form components, private image upload/preview and an operator-disclosed submission journal. Detail/list are creating-Admin-scoped minimal projections. Cashier requires explicit payment initiation, status/detail checks and a displayed expected amount; zero-price assisted orders require confirmation without QR, and external QR is drawn locally. Cash/zero lock-time amount validation passed native PG16 flow 39/39; a later native PG16 flow 43/43 added a persistent one-time provider intent before external contact. Category/advanced filters, large-catalog paging, keyword/status query plans, fresh buyer selection, unused-image lifecycle, cross-tab coordination and real Admin/Redis/Hyperdrive acceptance remain open. Feedback and five Work pages now have local route consumers. Work tokens stay separate from shopper login and in memory. No-hint entry and product send check the current SDK target; background/pagehide clear private state. A visible page with a userid hint cannot guarantee immediate clearing on an otherwise unobserved chat switch. Real Enterprise WeChat SDK/employee authorization, authenticated feedback submission, native devices and deployment are not verified.
